clauses.reason: The order amends Executive Order 7293 by striking the words "Naval Mission to Brazil:" after Exception No. 1 in subdivision B of Table I and substituting "Naval Missions to Brazil and Peru:". Before: "Naval Mission to Brazil:". After: "Naval Missions to Brazil and Peru:". Executive Order 8107, signed 1939-05-03, struck "Naval Missions to Brazil and Peru:" and substituted "Naval Missions to Brazil, Peru, and Colombia:"; under the strike-and-insert ruling (research/readiness/owner_rulings/2026-10-21-strike-and-insert.md) the amendment is a later event and the clause continues, amended, until the parent order ends. Executive Order 8704, signed 1941-03-04, supersedes Executive Order 7293 as amended by Executive Orders No. 7831, No. 8107, No. 8440 and No. 8674, and is effective as of its date except as to quarters allowance within the continental limits of the United States, as to which it is effective 1941-07-01. The naval-mission exception for Brazil and Peru is not a continental quarters allowance, so the first end is 1941-03-04; the 1941-07-01 date is the disclosed alternative. State on 2026-10-14: terminated by express supersession of the parent order as amended.

research_rationale:
Executive Order 7831 of March 7, 1938 amends Executive Order 7293 of February 14, 1936 (allowances for quarters and subsistence for enlisted men) by striking the words "Naval Mission to Brazil:" after "Exception No. 1" in subdivision "B.-Special" of Table I and substituting "Naval Missions to Brazil and Peru:". The held text is the Federal Register print as machine-extracted from the official PDF (3 FR 641), closing number [No. 7831]; it is one operative sentence and one clause. The wording it installed was itself struck and replaced by Executive Order 8107 (1939-05-03), which substituted "Naval Missions to Brazil, Peru, and Colombia:"; under the strike-and-insert ruling that is a later event and the amended text continues until its parent order ends. The parent order, Executive Order 7293 as amended, was superseded by Executive Order 8704, signed 1941-03-04, effective as of its date except as to quarters allowance within the continental limits of the United States (effective 1941-07-01). The Brazil and Peru naval-mission exception concerns missions outside the continental United States, so the 1941-03-04 date governs it; the 1941-07-01 date is disclosed as the alternative for any reading that treats the exception as a continental quarters allowance.
